nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Aspen Audio Authenticity Question
nodes.description: Persistent investigation target: whether the released TPUSA audio of Charlie Kirk nominating Erika as CEO is authentic, AI-generated, or fabricated. Supported by donor testimony, AI-voice source, and Blake Neff's prior AI concern.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk Educational Credentials Discrepancy
nodes.description: Investigation target: reconciliation of Erika Kirk's LinkedIn degree claims (ASU magna/summa laude, double degree in political science & international relations, Liberty University Ed.D.) with public records showing no honors, no double degree, and ASU not offering the international relations degree in 2012.

nodes.name: Nick Shirley Background and Backing Verification
nodes.description: Investigation target: verification of Nick Shirley's claimed journalism credentials, plausibility of his Brazilian favela infiltration story, and identification of who is backing him in the media ecosystem.

nodes.name: Project Constitution / TPUSA Divorce Rumor Verification
nodes.description: Investigation target: whether the Project Constitution divorce rumor regarding Andrew Kolvet had a factual basis, and the proportionality of TPUSA's response.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Primary investigative subject of the series; relevant in this episode as the victim whose case is being reopened.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the NYT op-ed (A-2348) and named in the Vance-referenced grief account.

nodes.name: Spencer Cox
nodes.description: Utah Governor Cox, referenced for declaring the investigation concluded and the suspect in custody, after which the feds contacted the rooftop witnesses on September 15.

nodes.name: Tyler Bowyer
nodes.description: TPUSA figure the host questions over X posts, security-adjacent roles, and timeline overlaps with Erika Kirk.

nodes.name: Brian Harpole Fort Huachuca Presence Verification
nodes.description: Investigation target: whether Brian Harpole was present at Fort Huachuca on the date alleged by Mitch, given the disputed alibi photo, the flight records that do not cover the alleged sighting window, and Paramount Tactical's admission the alibi photo is not of Erika's son.

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host; target of paid clipping and DoD-adjacent smear; satirizes Candyland nanny comments; organizes tip intake.

nodes.name: Andrew Kolvet
nodes.description: Atlantic quotes him denying TPUSA Latvian contractors; host says talk to friend Blake.

nodes.name: Patrick Bet-David
nodes.description: Host of PBD Podcast; platform through which Sosnick segment was aired.

nodes.name: Alex Clark
nodes.description: Podcaster named by host and defended by AllieBeth Stuckey (A-1537.1) against host's accusation of misrepresenting Charlie Kirk's stance on architecture.

nodes.name: John Mappin
nodes.description: Referenced by viewer comment "fam"; author of "The Perfumed Pervert" essay.

nodes.name: Blake Neff
nodes.description: Commenter analogy "Blake Nef thing" for high-place gaslighting; host agrees pattern.

nodes.name: Nick Shirley
nodes.description: Independent journalist; host revisits him as relatively unknown figure pushed on Somali daycare welfare story and as last guest on the Charlie Kirk Show, booked by Andrew Kolvet. Prior CKA coverage existed only as investigation topics N-1632 / N-2064.

nodes.name: Brian Harpole
nodes.description: Comments: hospital supposedly did not know they were coming vs redirect audio to Timpanogos.

nodes.name: Baron Coleman
nodes.description: Announced guest host during Candace maternity leave; subject of pre-appearance X attacks and old-interview digs.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet denied divorce rumor via social media
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet publicly denied divorce rumors via X post, telling Project Constitution "LOL, you wish, fat boy" and instructing them to keep his wife's name out of their mouth.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact wording of Kolvet's post and timestamp against X archives; identify whether any divorce filings exist in Arizona court records.

claims.label: Project Constitution reported Andrew Kolvet divorce rumor
claims.claim: An X account identifying as Project Constitution reported that Andrew Kolvet was getting a divorce.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the author and posting history of the Project Constitution account; obtain the original post content and any cited basis.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer accused rumor-mongers of "reckless disregard for truth"
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer publicly stated he has had "numerous things like this said about us" and characterized such reporting as "reckless disregard for truth from people who call themselves investigators."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original X post and any subsequent posts by Bowyer; cross-reference his stated history of false rumors.

claims.label: Blake Neff defended Andrew Kolvet's WHCD absence
claims.claim: Blake Neff publicly disputed the implication that Andrew Kolvet's wife was absent from the White House Correspondents Dinner, arguing that WHCD attendance requires press-issued invitations, that Kolvet lives in Phoenix, and questioning how anyone would know his wife's travel preferences.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; check WHCD invitation lists if publicly available.

claims.label: Donors present in Aspen assert Charlie Kirk's "I appoint my wife" audio was faked
claims.claim: Per Candace, donors who were present at the Aspen event assert that the TPUSA-released audio of Charlie Kirk saying "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me" was faked, and that the moment never happened. Candace states this report has been on the desk for 39 days as of this episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific donors by name; obtain written or recorded statements; secure the original unedited audio if TPUSA retains it; obtain independent audio-forensic analysis of the released clip.

claims.label: Released audio clip contains Charlie Kirk saying "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA"
claims.claim: The audio clip released by Turning Point USA contains Charlie Kirk stating three times "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me. Erika would do a great job."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate TPUSA's original release of the clip; obtain timestamped metadata; compare against any verified recordings of Charlie Kirk's voice.

claims.label: Marcus Wada provides AI voice services for TPUSA presentations
claims.claim: Per a source who came forward, Turning Point USA employee Marcus Wada offers AI voice generation services for TPUSA presentations.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Wada's TPUSA employment and the scope of his AI services; identify any other clients or projects; obtain a sample of his AI-generated voice work.

claims.label: TPUSA typically uses AI-cloned voice of Pastor John Amanchukwu in presentations
claims.claim: Per the source, Turning Point USA presentations typically feature AI-generated voice-over using Pastor John Amanchukwu's voice (described as with his permission).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a TPUSA presentation featuring the contested voice; verify with Pastor Amanchukwu whether he consented to voice cloning; secure source's full statement.

claims.label: John Mappin publicly shared Aspen donor's claim the audio moment never happened
claims.claim: John Mappin shared on X that an Aspen donor told him the moment depicted in the audio never happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Mappin's original X post and identify the donor he referenced; obtain Mappin's full statement.

claims.label: Kimberly Klacik publicly questioned why the audio matters
claims.claim: Kimberly Klacik publicly argued on X that since the TPUSA board elected Erika Kirk as CEO and no donors had publicly questioned the decision, the authenticity of the audio does not matter.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; obtain TPUSA board meeting minutes documenting Erika's CEO election.

claims.label: Erika Kirk received honorary doctorate from Hillsdale College
claims.claim: Erika Kirk delivered the Hillsdale College commencement address and was awarded an honorary doctorate.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Hillsdale College's official press release or commencement program; verify the date and the credentials cited for the award.

claims.label: Brian Allen publicly characterized Hillsdale's honorary doctorate for Erika as DEI
claims.claim: Brian Allen publicly argued on X that Hillsdale College awarding Erika Kirk an honorary doctorate and commencement platform contradicts Hillsdale's stated anti-DEI position, characterizing the decision as "Diversity, equity and inclusion for me and not for thee."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; cross-reference Hillsdale's public statements on DEI.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's old LinkedIn claimed ASU magna cum laude graduation
claims.claim: Erika Kirk's older LinkedIn page (since removed) stated she graduated from Arizona State University magna cum laude, in connection with a Great American Race audition video.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived versions of the LinkedIn page (Wayback Machine or other captures); verify against ASU graduation records.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's LinkedIn was upgraded to claim summa cum laude with double degree
claims.claim: Erika Kirk later updated her LinkedIn page to state she graduated summa cum laude with a double degree in political science and international relations.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived LinkedIn captures showing both versions; verify degree titles and honors with ASU registrar.

claims.label: ASU did not offer international relations degree in 2012
claims.claim: Per Baron Coleman and other online researchers, Arizona State University did not offer an international relations degree program at all in 2012, when Erika Kirk claims to have graduated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain ASU's archived 2012 course catalog directly from the university or library archives; verify the degree offerings list.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's LinkedIn claimed Doctor of Education from Liberty University
claims.claim: Erika Kirk's LinkedIn page lists a Doctor of Education in Christian Leadership from Liberty University, which she did not actually earn (took only a couple of credits toward the goal).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Liberty's Ed.D. in Christian Leadership program; obtain Liberty's records on Erika Kirk's actual enrollment.

claims.label: Nick Shirley claimed to have infiltrated Brazilian gang in 48 hours
claims.claim: Nick Shirley is associated with a video claiming he infiltrated the most dangerous gang in Brazil within 48 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original favela video; verify any corroborating evidence (local news, authorities, contacts).

claims.label: Patrick Bet-David hosted Nick Shirley and discussed Candace's prior skepticism
claims.claim: Patrick Bet-David's show hosted Nick Shirley, during which Shirley stated that Candace Owens "came after me uh a while back" and didn't believe his Brazilian favela video; Bet-David asked "Why would Candace Owens come after you?"
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full PBD interview clip and timestamp; verify PBD's framing of prior coverage.

claims.label: Alex Clark publicly defended Nick Shirley against Candace Owens
claims.claim: Alex Clark publicly wrote on X: "Nick Shirley is a real journalist. Candace Owens is not."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post and Alex Clark's relationship with Nick Shirley.

claims.label: Brian Harpole's alibi flights were 1:49 PM Dallas to Salt Lake City on the 9th
claims.claim: According to flight records shown to Candace during her private interview with Erika, Brian Harpole's alibi flights on the 9th departed Dallas at 1:49 PM for Salt Lake City — a window that does not cover the morning timeframe when Mitch reported seeing him at Fort Huachuca.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the flight records independently through airline records or TSA; obtain Brian Harpole's full itinerary for the date in question.

claims.label: Fort Huachuca alibi photograph was provided by Andrew Kolvet
claims.claim: A photograph allegedly depicting Erika Kirk with her children at Fort Huachuca was provided to online defenders by Andrew Kolvet, with the explicit instruction "don't share."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original alibi photo and Andrew Kolvet's accompanying message; verify provenance.

claims.label: Paramount Tactical admitted the Fort Huachuca alibi photo boy is not Erika Kirk's son
claims.claim: Paramount Tactical admitted over the weekend that the boy depicted in the Fort Huachuca alibi photograph is not Erika Kirk's son; a source close to the family reportedly says the child is neither of Erika's children.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Paramount Tactical's specific admission statement; identify the actual child in the photo.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet coordinated the Harpole alibi pushback with Paramount Tactical and Valhalla
claims.claim: Per host, Andrew Kolvet was the coordinator behind the Paramount Tactical and Valhalla YouTube efforts to push back on the Fort Huachuca allegations against Brian Harpole, despite Erika's claim that Kolvet was being moved off of PR responsibilities.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct evidence of coordination (emails, DMs, communications); obtain statement from Kolvet, Paramount Tactical, and Valhalla.

claims.label: Erika Kirk provided Candace with Brian Harpole's alibi during their private interview
claims.claim: During Candace's private interview with Erika Kirk, Erika volunteered Brian Harpole's flight records as his alibi — which Candace notes did not actually cover the timeframe of Mitch's sighting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Candace's documented record of the interview; verify the flight records independently.
